text:
Bitcoin extended its relief rally to $65,900 on June 15, 2026, as the U.S.-Iran peace agreement — including reopening of the Strait of Hormuz — drove a broad risk-on rotation. Spot BTC ETFs logged net inflows of $85.8 million, with BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC leading the reversal after weeks of cumulative outflows exceeding $2 billion. The SEC's proposal to rescind Regulation NMS Rules 611 and 610(e) — flagged by Benchmark analysts as the year's most consequential crypto policy action — would remove key barriers to tokenized equities trading on public blockchains. EU MiCA's transition window closes July 1, threatening up to 75% of non-compliant crypto providers with loss of EU market access.

All eyes now turn to the June 16–17 FOMC meeting, chaired for the first time by Kevin Warsh. With U.S. CPI at 4.2% in May and rates held at 3.50%–3.75%, markets anticipate formal removal of the Fed's easing bias. U.S. 10-year Treasury yields near cycle highs and a resilient DXY are sustaining structural headwinds for non-yielding digital assets. A hawkish dot-plot revision Wednesday could re-test BTC support near $63,600 and compress the $2.24 trillion crypto market cap.
